Beowulf - The Game.name: Beowulf: The Game
Beowulf - The Game.summary: Beowulf: The Game is a hack and slash game for TOD and consoles, based on Robert Zemeckis' version of the poem Beowulf. The game was announced by Ubisoft on 22 May 2007 during its Ubidays event in Paris.[5] It was released on November 13, 2007 in the United States. The characters are voiced by the original actors who starred in the film.

Blood Drive.name: Blood Drive
Blood Drive.summary: Blood Drive is a vehicular combat video game for PlayStation 3 and Xbox 360, developed by Sidhe, published by Activision, and released worldwide in November 2010.

Sengoku Musou 3 - Empires.name: Samurai Warriors 3: Empires
Sengoku Musou 3 - Empires.summary: Samurai Warriors 3: Empires is the second standalone expansion of the 2009 game Samurai Warriors 3. Like the other Empires expansion, the game is more focused on the political and tactical battle system. The game features a different version of Historical Mode and Free Mode that fits with the Empires structure and retains the edit character feature.
